keyFindings.description: TestARecreatedBucketForgetsTheOldBucketsRecords locks only the held-set half of the reset branch. With only the queue reset (loop.go:256) removed it still passes (3/3 runs in the code-quality audit), because a kept queue entry for an uncached key is dropped by fileLocked when it pops and changes no count or publication; the doc's claim that a kept queue would count the old records is false. Its only support is a 1 s sleep and a wall-time guard (line 456) that fails the test (a required check) whenever the put, the cache wait and the first pass take a second. Fix: drop record 72, due, the guard and the sleep and reword the doc to the held count, or keep the queue claim and prove it from pass's returned ok right after the recreate, with no sleep.
